message:
Yes, `ref_pkt` calls `set_data` when `!data->seen_capabilities`. So the PoC needs to trigger `set_data` with the crafted packet.

Now, let me also check `git_pkt_parse_line` to make sure the packet is dispatched to `ref_pkt`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>sed -n '490,590p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libgit2/src/libgit2/transports/smart_pkt.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
